description: Land Acquisition - Poogalla & Narangalla, Kuliyapitiya West D/S Division,  Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, including their boundaries, extents, and current claimants. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
